news.title: Police investigate overnight incidents across metro Atlanta
news.summary: Police responded to multiple overnight incidents in metro Atlanta, including a shooting at a northwest Atlanta apartment complex, a death investigation near downtown and a separate call in Lithonia.

news.title: Douglasville man sentenced to life for sexually assaulting infant
news.summary: A 22-year-old Douglasville man has been sentenced to life in prison after pleading guilty to sexually assaulting a 10-month-old infant, prosecutors announced Tuesday.

news.title: How the FBI was tipped off to an alleged threat to shoot up a Cherokee County high school
news.summary: A tip to the FBI led to an investigation and three arrests in an alleged plot to carry out a school shooting at Cherokee High School.

news.title: Search for suspects after man beaten, carjacked in southwest Atlanta
news.summary: Police are asking for the public's help to identify armed thieves accused of beating a man and stealing his car in southwest Atlanta.

news.title: Newnan police shooting review hinges on self-defense, not chase, DA says
news.summary: The criminal review into the fatal police shooting of 18-year-old Zadarious Dorsey hinges on self-defense rather than whether the officer had legal grounds to chase him, prosecutors announced.

news.title: Three arrested in alleged plot to carry out a shooting at Cherokee High School
news.summary: Three individuals have been arrested for an alleged plot to shoot at Cherokee High School, according to Canton police.

news.title: 3 arrested in alleged Cherokee High School shooting plot
news.summary: Canton police have taken three people into custody after uncovering an alleged conspiracy to commit a shooting at Cherokee High School.

news.title: Woman arrested in Augusta area after child found dead in southwest Atlanta, sources say
news.summary: Police have not officially released the child's identity or exact age; sources told 11Alive the child is a 4-year-old boy.

news.title: Family says brother of 4-year-old found dead in Atlanta home also seriously injured
news.summary: Jasmaine Smoak, 32, who is not the boys' mother, was arrested in Wilkes County.
